sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Do you want to learn English while feeling relaxed? This video combines soothing ASMR sounds with essential English vocabulary for beginners. Get ready to learn and relax. Repeat with me and try?
sentences.tc: 您想在輕鬆的同時學習英語嗎？該影片將舒緩的 ASMR 聲音與初學者的基本英語詞彙結合。準備好學習和放鬆。跟我重複一遍並嘗試一下？

sentences.en: We learned today. It can be a pleasant sound to you or maybe an unpleasant sound. Now relax and learn English with me. I hear tapping sounds.
sentences.tc: 我們今天學到了。這對您來說可能是令人愉快的聲音，也可能是令人不愉快的聲音。現在放鬆心情，和我一起學英文吧。我聽到敲擊聲。

sentences.en: I like tapping sounds. Tapping on a table. Tapping on a glass. Tapping on a phone. I think tapping sounds are sharp noises to my ears.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡敲擊聲。敲擊桌子。敲擊玻璃。敲擊電話。我認為敲擊聲對我來說是尖銳的噪音。

sentences.en: Would you describe tapping sounds? I hear crinkling sounds?
sentences.tc: 您能描述一下敲擊聲嗎？我聽到嘎吱聲？

sentences.en: Would you describe crinkling sounds? I hear whispering sounds. Whisper. I also like whispering sounds. Whispering in a soft voice. Whispering in my ear. Whispering sounds are very soothing for me?
sentences.tc: 你能描述一下嘎吱作響的聲音嗎？我聽到竊竊私語的聲音。耳語。我也喜歡竊竊私語的聲音。用輕柔的聲音呢喃著。在我耳邊低語。耳語聲對我來說非常舒緩？
